title: Kind to All
story:
A shopkeeper noticed a small boy standing outside his store.

The boy looked at the fruits inside.

He did not come in.

He just stood there quietly.

The shopkeeper called him.

“Come inside,” he said.

The boy hesitated.

“I don’t have money,” he replied softly.

The shopkeeper smiled.

He picked up a fresh fruit and gave it to him.

The boy’s eyes widened.

“For me?”

“Yes,” the man said.

“Just take it.”

The boy smiled with joy.

He ran off happily.

A man watching nearby asked,

“Why did you give it for free?”

The shopkeeper replied,

“Kindness should not depend on what we get back.”

In life, we often show kindness to those who deserve it.

Or those who can return it.

But God is good to all.

His compassion reaches everyone.

Not because we deserve it.

But because He is good.

When we reflect His heart,

we become a blessing to others.
life_lesson:
God shows kindness to everyone.

Let your kindness reflect His heart, without expecting anything in return.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your goodness and compassion.

You are kind to all people.

Help me to reflect Your heart.

Teach me to show kindness without expecting anything back.

Make me a blessing to those around me.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you show kindness only to those who deserve it?

Can you reflect God’s compassion to everyone?

What is one act of kindness you can do today?
verse:
The Lord is good to all.
He has compassion on all He has made.
